prompt:
You write realistic customer-support tickets for testing a ticket router.

Two intents the router must tell apart:
A = suspicious_login: reports sign-in activity they do not recognize
B = two_factor: trouble with two-factor codes or the authenticator device

Write 2 tickets for each level below (10 tickets in all), each 1-3 sentences, in a customer's own voice, varied in tone and detail. Never name the intents or use their exact wording.
- clear_a: plainly A, not B.
- lean_a: mostly A, with some features of B.
- even: genuinely ambiguous between A and B; a careful person could not tell which.
- lean_b: mostly B, with some features of A.
- clear_b: plainly B, not A.

Answer with JSON only: {"tickets": [{"level": "clear_a", "text": "..."}, ...]}

message.content: {"tickets":[{"level":"clear_a","text":"I got an email saying my account was opened from a phone in Prague last night, but I was asleep and have never been there. I didn’t log in yesterday, and I’d like to know how to end that session."},{"level":"lean_a","text":"I saw a notice that someone signed in from a new browser while I was at work. I’m not sure whether I’m having trouble getting in or should be worried about the alert."},{"level":"even","text":"The account page is asking me to verify something, and I also got a notice about a new session. I can’t tell whether the verification step is failing or the session notice is the real issue."},{"level":"lean_b","text":"I can’t get into my account because the codes from my authenticator keep being rejected. There was also a login notice from a city I don’t recognize, though I’m not sure when that happened."},{"level":"lean_b","text":"My phone was replaced yesterday, and now the account keeps asking for a code I can’t generate. I noticed an unfamiliar device in the security page while trying to sort it out."},{"level":"clear_b","text":"The six-digit numbers in my authenticator app aren’t accepted, even though I’m entering them right away. I can access the account from another device, but I’m stuck at the verification screen on this one."},{"level":"clear_b","text":"I switched to a new phone and can’t get the authenticator set up for my account. Could you help me reconnect it or use another way to verify?"}]}
message.reasoning:

I believe the auth code may not work due to the unfamiliar location alert I saw yesterday. Overall, it seems like there’s no unknown activity. I’ll create a list of 10 organized tickets in a clear format without using "two-factor" and make sure to keep the voice varied.
